description: Turn a long talking video (podcast, stream, interview, webinar, 2 minutes to 2 hours) into its best moments as vertical 9:16 clips (15-60 s each) with word-by-word captions, framed on whoever is talking (two people on screen are stacked). Upload the video first with pixeldojo_upload. Costs 3 credits per minute of the source (at least 15), charged only when the clips are delivered; tell the user the price before starting. Then call status until done (about 5-15 minutes).

action.description: start (default): begin a run. status: check a run by clipper_id; call about every 60 s until it is done.

title.description: Start: a name for the run; the clips are saved in a Library folder with it.

video_url.description: Start: the long video on the PixelDojo CDN (upload it first with pixeldojo_upload). MP4, 2 minutes to 2 hours, people talking.

name: pixeldojo_clipper
title: Clip long video into shorts
